options.content:
## Budget & Cost Control

Track LLM spending across teams and models. Configure token pricing, monitor budget utilization, and identify cost optimization opportunities with per-model and per-organization breakdowns.

### OpenAI
| Model | Input | Output |
|-------|-------|--------|
| GPT-4o | $${openai_4o_in} | $${openai_4o_out} |
| GPT-4o-mini | $${openai_mini_in} | $${openai_mini_out} |
| o1 | $${openai_o1_in} | $${openai_o1_out} |

### Anthropic
| Model | Input | Output |
|-------|-------|--------|
| Claude Opus | $${claude_opus_in} | $${claude_opus_out} |
| Claude Sonnet | $${claude_sonnet_in} | $${claude_sonnet_out} |
| Claude Haiku | $${claude_haiku_in} | $${claude_haiku_out} |

### Google
| Model | Input | Output |
|-------|-------|--------|
| Gemini Pro | $${gemini_pro_in} | $${gemini_pro_out} |
| Gemini Flash | $${gemini_flash_in} | $${gemini_flash_out} |
24-hour summary of token consumption and request volumes for cost tracking and capacity planning.
